description: API routes and backend logic - Create all Next.js API route handlers for the marketplace including authentication endpoints, instructor/student CRUD, matching engine endpoint, booking/payment processing, messaging, reviews, and progress tracking.
steps: Create src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts - NextAuth route handler using the auth config from src/lib/auth.ts
Create src/app/api/instructors/route.ts - GET (list/search instructors with filters), POST (create instructor profile)
Create src/app/api/instructors/[id]/route.ts - GET (instructor details), PUT (update profile), DELETE (deactivate)
Create src/app/api/instructors/[id]/availability/route.ts - GET (available slots), POST (add slot), PUT (update slot), DELETE (remove slot)
Create src/app/api/instructors/[id]/reviews/route.ts - GET (instructor reviews list)
Create src/app/api/students/route.ts - GET (list students for admin), POST (create student profile)
Create src/app/api/students/[id]/route.ts - GET (student details), PUT (update preferences)
Create src/app/api/matching/route.ts - POST (run matching engine for a student, returns ranked instructors with scores and factor breakdowns)
Create src/app/api/bookings/route.ts - GET (list bookings for user), POST (create booking with Stripe payment intent)
Create src/app/api/bookings/[id]/route.ts - GET (booking details), PUT (update status - confirm/cancel/complete)
Create src/app/api/bookings/[id]/review/route.ts - POST (submit review for completed booking)
Create src/app/api/payments/webhook/route.ts - POST (Stripe webhook handler for payment confirmations, refunds)
Create src/app/api/payments/connect/route.ts - POST (create Stripe Connect account link for instructor onboarding)
Create src/app/api/messages/route.ts - GET (list conversations), POST (send message)
Create src/app/api/messages/[conversationId]/route.ts - GET (messages in conversation), PUT (mark as read)
Create src/app/api/progress/route.ts - GET (student progress entries), POST (instructor logs progress for student)
Create src/app/api/progress/[id]/route.ts - GET (specific progress entry), PUT (update progress notes)
Create src/app/api/admin/instructors/route.ts - GET (pending verifications), PUT (approve/reject ADI verification)
Create src/lib/services/matching-service.ts - Matching service class that orchestrates the scoring algorithm with configurable weights
Create src/lib/services/booking-service.ts - Booking service handling creation, cancellation, instructor continuity (auto-suggest replacement)
Create src/lib/services/payment-service.ts - Payment service wrapping Stripe operations (create intent, process webhook, handle refunds, calculate 15% commission)
Create src/lib/services/notification-service.ts - Notification service for booking confirmations, cancellations, messages
acceptance_criteria: All API routes follow Next.js App Router route handler conventions (export async function GET/POST/PUT/DELETE)
Routes include proper authentication checks using getServerSession
Request bodies are validated using Zod schemas from src/lib/validators.ts
Error responses use consistent format with appropriate HTTP status codes
Matching endpoint returns scored results with factor breakdowns
Payment routes handle Stripe Connect flow with 15% commission
Booking cancellation triggers instructor continuity logic
All routes are properly typed with TypeScript
verification: Verify all API route files exist
Check TypeScript syntax on key route files
Verify consistent error handling patterns across routes
findings: All 22 files created (18 API routes + 4 services). Cannot run npm run build due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode (no node_modules). Verified: all files have proper exports, consistent error handling patterns, auth checks via getServerSession, and Zod validation. The payment-service.ts imports from stripe.ts use the existing helper functions (createPaymentIntent, createConnectAccount, createAccountLink, handleWebhookEvent).
